The '''''Pongeeta''-class swamp speeder''' was a type of [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] based on ancient [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Fanboat/Legends|fanboats]] that was used to traverse the swamps of [[Varl/Legends|Varl]]<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref> and [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="Hunt Ziro">{{TCW|Hunt for Ziro}}</ref>
